description: Electrical parts of machinery or apparatus; n.e.c. in chapter 85
product: Other parts of waste and scraps

retired.note: HS 2022 renumbered 8548.90 to 8548.00, but narrowed the heading at the same time by moving electrical and electronic waste and scrap out to the new heading 85.49. The successor is the same line under a new number covering less ground.

lineage.familyNote: These codes together cover this product across the HS 2022 revision. They do not overlap in time, so stacking them gives a continuous series without apportioning anything.

coverage.retired: Withdrawn from the Harmonized System after 2021. Rows still filed under this number are residuals, not a world total, so no figure is published.
